label: ⑥ 花叔 Design：生辰画册
direction: A high-fidelity authored bilingual ART EDITORIAL HOMEPAGE. Think of a beautifully paced art publication's typographic logic, but this is entirely a flat functional website, not a physical book mockup. Neutral porcelain-grey ground, rich black text, a single very small cinnabar functional detail. Refined modern Chinese Song typography paired with a quiet Latin serif; no calligraphy, ink-wash website background, beige nostalgia or gold ornament. Use the opening's typographic arrangement as the memorable move: a slim vertical Chinese invitation near a deliberate central gutter, while two intact heterogeneous artworks occupy unequal but balanced open fields on either side. Place the colorful pixel work at serious artwork scale, not a cute accent sticker; the sheep remains its own independent work. A restrained wordmark, plain navigation, quiet captions and one obvious gift-discovery link make the page usable. The lower section continues the editorial rhythm in a different arrangement. This product's birthday dedication has created the form; no numbered sections, top eyebrow, decorative arrows, random stamps, excessive ornaments or product-card grid.
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE design comp for "proof of cake", a niche onchain birthday art gifting platform for crypto-native people, 1536x1024 edge-to-edge. The client wants the feeling of a curated luxury boutique: restrained, personal, selective, not a marketplace. Platform visual identity stays independent of artwork aesthetics. The attached tall sheep ink painting is ARTWORK CONTENT ONLY, not the site's style. Include it intact, and one contrasting colorful pixel birthday artwork; a third small colorful abstract work is optional. Native colors and proportions stay intact. Show a real navigable screen and the start of the following section, no device frame, poster, mockup of a physical book, framed wall, room, vase, plinth or showroom render. No catalogue grid, fake prices/editions/artists/reviews, giant checkout form or crypto telemetry. Real UI content: brand "proof of cake", navigation "作品", "关于", "连接钱包", brief "为一个人，珍藏一份心意。", a clear understated "挑选生日礼物", and small "设计预览". No excessive tags or filter pills.
